purpose: Apply the retroactive Eastern-Fleet suppression concept to the first day of INITIAL using actual March reconnaissance, submarine and air-force slack.

Japanese_information_before_sortie.strategic: HIGH confidence that a reinforced Eastern Fleet with Illustrious and heavy ships is based at Ceylon.
Japanese_information_before_sortie.operational: LOW-MEDIUM. The failed/low-yield 7-Feb reconnaissance and subsequent loss of western long-range bomber/fighter depth prevent a continuously fresh Trincomalee port plot.
Japanese_information_before_sortie.sortie_probability: MODERATE in staff terms after the fleet reappears from SLEUTH and continues training, but no exact 8-Mar departure time is known.

08Mar_detection_geometry.observation_effect: Outside routine visual/radar coverage and awkward for the now-short-ranged western IJN strike/search residue. Long-range IJA reconnaissance could physically reach parts of the corridor but lacks a fresh cue and is not credited an automatic broad-ocean find.
08Mar_detection_geometry.radio: RN W/T silence after 1630 removes the easiest same-day cue.

decision_gates.motive: HIGHER_THAN_FEBRUARY if a real east/northeast RN movement is confirmed, because Chittagong/Andaman positions and coastal shipping could be threatened.
decision_gates.capability: PARTIAL. Submarines and IJA reconnaissance remain useful; IJN 705 long-range G4M capability has been transferred into K706 eastward and 331 fighter element is leaving.
decision_gates.information_quality: FAIL_FOR_ATTACK at 8-Mar T24: no fresh track.
decision_gates.opportunity_cost: HIGH for re-importing K706/S603 or releasing mobile-fleet heavy cruisers.

08Mar_actions: Raise Ceylon/Bay surveillance priority one step, but do not invent a departure sighting.
Keep Port Blair/Akyab/Patenga reconnaissance assets available for westward sectors if a cue appears on 9 Mar.
Treat RO-111 outbound patrol and I-166 patrol as useful Bay pressure/intelligence assets, but do not teleport either onto INITIAL.
Oyodo group remains contact-exploitation reserve; no sortie without maintained track.
No Trincomalee air raid, no 705 B5N deep-Bay strike, no Suzuya/Kumano release, no carrier/battlefleet reaction.
next_trigger: On 9-12 Mar, rerun detection as the RN force moves north toward 13-15N and later deliberately breaks W/T silence to advertise Bay presence. A cue can then create an actual Japanese reconnaissance response without retroactively granting 8-Mar contact.
